in_marathi.name: Pramendra
in_marathi.long_meaning: Pramendra हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Pramendra is a compound name derived from the Sanskrit words 'pra' meaning supreme and 'mendra' meaning light or radiance. It represents the supreme source of light and wisdom.
